snippet.title: What is Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979? | Post-Apocalyptic Lore (AI Voice)
snippet.description:
🟢 Wishlist JUST MADNESS: EARTH APOCALYPSE 1979 on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652470/Just_Madness_Earth_Apocalypse_1979/

Our Game Studio: https://rodrigobanzato.com
My collections on FAB: https://www.fab.com/sellers/Rodrigo%20Banzato

***

IMPORTANT UPDATE:
Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979 is the new official title for the game previously developed under the name "Max Madness". Same terrifying vision, new atmospheric scale.

ABOUT THIS VIDEO:
A brief history of the setting, world-building, and lore behind our upcoming post-apocalyptic survival game. The cinematic English voiceover for this video was an experiment created using advanced AI voice tools to enhance the dark storytelling.

ABOUT THE GAME:
Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979 is an atmospheric survival horror game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore harsh environments, manage your scarce resources, and survive the horrors of the wasteland.

🔗 Follow our development journey:
* Crowdfunding Campaign: https://www.rodrigobanzato.com/donate
* IndieDB/ModDB: https://www.indiedb.com/members/rodrigobanzato/games
